text:
jess: Heads-up — dogfood onboarding hit a billing surprise after we rotated a project key. Traced it to env var shadowing.

jess: Short repro below.
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org-0000
export RW_API_KEY_PROJECT=proj-2222
./run-sample
# requests show org-0000 used in Authorization header after rotation
```

omar: I dug into the SDK loader. A refactor in auth-loader.js switched to loading REDWOOD_API_KEY early to preserve legacy behavior. That now shadows more-specific keys during runtime reloads.

omar: Logs from the repro run: `auth.loader: variables=[REDWOOD_API_KEY, RW_API_KEY_PROJECT] picked=REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

winona: Oof. We need three things: 1) clear precedence (most-specific wins), 2) a startup diagnostic that prints the chosen var (masked), and 3) telemetry event so we can see how many onboards have both keys set.

sam: Also streaming clients: when a token rotates mid-connection we get 401s and the client currently terminates. Suggestion: if tokenProvider.refresh exists, attempt refresh once, resume the stream if successful; otherwise emit `auth.rotation.failed` to the app with a reason.

jess: Can we add a non-fatal warn at init when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and any RW_API_KEY_* exist? Make it prominent in logs and a telemetry ping with anonymized flag. That way we can correlate mis-bills.

telemetry-bot: new telemetry event created: sdk.auth.conflict_detected (fields: conflict_type, sdk_version) — anonymized.

omar: Implementation plan:
- revert the loader refactor that prioritized REDWOOD_API_KEY
- enforce precedence: RW_API_KEY_PROJECT > RW_API_KEY_SERVICE > RW_API_KEY_ORG > REDWOOD_API_KEY
- emit a one-time WARN with masked suffix of selected key (e.g., ****2222)
- send telemetry event sdk.auth.conflict_detected when ambiguous envs present
- for streams: add token refresh hook and single retry behavior

winona: API-wise: expose SDK option `auth.precedence=['project','service','org','legacy']` so infra code can override if needed. Also expose `auth.telemetry=false` for privacy-conscious customers.

jess: Tests: unit matrix for env permutations, integration test that rotates key while an SSE client is connected and asserts either resume or rotation.failed event. CI should fail if we regress.

omar: I'll draft a small PR that adds the diag log + telemetry ping. Will include a compatibility env RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT=true that preserves old behavior for one release cycle.

sam: I'll prototype the stream refresh logic and add sampleapp example showing reconnection flow.

jess: Docs: add a short "Auth env precedence" section in onboarding with a migration snippet to `unset REDWOOD_API_KEY` if using project keys. Also call out the RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT and auth.precedence override.

cli-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1599 "sdk: env shadowing + stream token refresh + telemetry"

jess: thanks all. Prioritize the telemetry + warn first so we can catch new onboards, then follow with stream fix. Closing for now; reopen if more cases crop up. :white_check_mark:
